summary: An ad hoc terminal retirement of an owned-set member no longer wedges the set: publication keeps the member retired and reports it, and an audit set records the retirement as source debt

replay.detail: Existing revisions and claims replay unchanged; a member kept retired is an ordinary entry in the revision's retired map.

schema.detail: No SQL migration or new claim kind; source.debt.recorded gains the verb retire, and a set preview's changes map may report retired.

rules.detail: A set publication that still declares a terminally retired agent no longer fails with 409 recipient-retired: it keeps the member retired, reports changes=retired with the effect 'keep terminally retired by ACTOR: REASON; drop it from the source', and applies the rest. Omitting such a member reports the same change, is not a retirement by the publication and does not count toward the --confirm-retire threshold. An agents retire that an audit set accepts also records source debt with verb retire; that debt stays open while the source declares the member and closes as adopted with the first publication that omits it. Enforce still refuses the retirement, and sets without a policy record no debt.

compatibility.detail: Revisions keep their shape, so older daemons accept them; an older publisher closes retire debt as closed instead of keeping it open.

manual.detail: To clear the open debt and the report, drop the retired member from the set's source.

recovery.detail: Terminal retirement stays irreversible; nothing to recover.
